Priya S.: AuroraEdge (FPGA partner) signed the EAP NDA with minor redlines. They want us to validate low-power edge perf. Can we scope access + bench plan?

Anton M.: I can handle access. Two modes: ssh jumpbox or OCI images in their registry. They prefer runs inside their orchestrator for power telemetry.

Daria L.: Perf scope: cold-start P50/P95, KV cache behavior, batch scaling, and energy-per-token. Need sample workloads (chat short, long completion, embeddings).

Carlos P.: Legal flagged firmware screenshots clause. We'll request an amendment allowing aggregated metrics and redacted syslogs only.

marketplace-bot: New partnership record aurora-edge-eap-2026 created.

Priya S.: Action items: Anton get creds and confirm power cap, Daria prepare harness and 3 workloads, Carlos push legal carve-out, Priya draft marketplace blurb if Day 5 review looks good.

Anton M.: Aurora offered rotated OCI creds and can bump power from 45W to 65W during test window. I'll request a temp raise and a secondary token for long runs.

Daria L.: I'll publish a lightweight harness: run_edge_bench.sh with power sampling (1s) and output aggregated.json with histograms + token counts only. No raw prompts.

Carlos P.: Legal approved an amendment on the condition we store only aggregated metrics + per-batch hashes, no firmware screenshots. I'll attach the signed amendment to the partner record.

Priya S.: Timeline: Day 0 smoke, Day 1 baseline (FP32/int8), Day 3 quant sweep, Day 5 joint review. If all good, marketplace tile draft.

Anton M.: Confirmed rotated creds and a 3-hour test window scheduled for Thursday. Will run a 10-min smoke tomorrow and post results.

Daria L.: Smoke script added to repo and runbook. Output will go to a restricted S3 bucket.

Priya S.: Thanks — keep updates here and tag me for any escalation.
